subject.title: fix(agents): emit diagnostic when sessions_yield parks without continuation evidence

question: Should a yielded turn with no recognized continuation evidence always produce this user-visible diagnostic, and is the PR's evidence set the canonical definition of a valid continuation?
rationale: The bug is real, but deciding which states make a yield valid defines user-visible delivery and parent lifecycle policy beyond a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Confirm diagnostic contract
options.body: Approve the additive warning after confirming the shared predicate covers every supported continuation source.

options.title: Enforce at tool boundary
options.body: Pause this patch and instead reject invalid yields inside sessions_yield after plumbing canonical continuation state.

options.title: Allow manual-resume yields
options.body: Keep bare yield as a valid silent pause and document that the next inbound message is the intended resume path.
